Bill.BriefDescription: Increasing access to state government through accessible parking.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to increasing access to state government throughaccessible parking; adding a new section to chapter 46.61 RCW; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the public'saccess to their elected officials and the public's participation inlegislative affairs is essential to the health of a representativedemocracy. The legislature further finds that to ensure that thepublic maintains such access to the historic state capitol buildings,where legislative and executive affairs take place, there is a stateinterest in allowing open parking space in the vicinity of the historiccapitol campus.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, localauthorities are prohibited from enacting any ordinance or resolutionthat restricts parking on any street within five hundred yards of anyof the following state buildings: p. 1 SB 5830 (a) The governor's mansion; (b) The legislative building; (c) The John L. O'Brien building; (d) The Cherberg building; (e) The Newhouse building; (f) The Pritchard building; (g) The temple of justice; and (h) The insurance building. (2) A local authority may put a time restriction of four hours onparking as described under subsection (1) of this section between 9:00a.m. to 5:00 p.m. daily during the week between Monday morning andFriday evening.
